# Keystone First-Purchase Sales Policy
PORTABLE-AED-CABINET-16 may not sell below 427.70 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 445.90.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include vendor_id, onboarding_status, tax_doc_id in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
vendor_id: VEND-KEYSTONE-2026
onboarding_status: approved_conditional
tax_doc_id: W9-KEYSTONE-2026

# Vendor Onboarding Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-OE-104
Item: PORTABLE-AED-CABINET-16
Quantity: 16
Target unit price: 455.00
Required terms_json keys: vendor_id, onboarding_status, tax_doc_id.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include vendor_id, onboarding_status, tax_doc_id inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Vendor Management Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: vendor_id, onboarding_status, tax_doc_id.
